videos.title: Build a feedback loop that automatically turns real-world data into evals
videos.description: For AI product teams, the #1 engineering priority isn't prompt engineering or picking an agent framework—it's building a pipeline that summons real-world data and converts it into evals. This is the same principle as investing in CI for traditional software: you're building the platform that lets agents do the work engineers used to do manually. Without this feedback loop, you're stuck in whack-a-mole mode, fixing individual cases without systematic improvement.

videos.title: The Real Reason Trying Harder Never Works - Part 4 - Change
videos.description:
Get 30 days free of unlimited access of Brain.fm at https://www.brain.fm/solved

The Greeks called it akrasia: the gap between what you know you should do and what you actually do. Why does it exist? Why is it so stubborn? And why does willpower fail almost every single time? In this chapter, Mark and Drew get into Plato's chariot rider and two horses, the famous hospital checklist that saved 1,500 lives by doing almost nothing, and why putting your gym shoes by the door beats every morning routine ever invented. If change was as easy as more information, we'd all be billionaires with six-packs. It's not, and this is why.

videos.title: Why Being A Sports Star Is Overrated
videos.description:
Every World Cup creates another generation obsessed with being the next Pelé. Almost nobody stops to think about Zagallo. Not because Zagallo wasn't celebrated, but because his contribution is harder to explain in a highlight reel.

Pelé became the symbol. Zagallo helped create the conditions for the symbol to exist. And that's an uncomfortable truth about life: the most important thing you'll ever do may never look important while you're doing it.
